intro.zh: 围绕指定 HARTING Han 系列接口制作可拆卸机台、控制柜与设备模块连接电缆。以完整料号、对插件、回路图和安装环境定义组件；名称相近的外壳、插芯与触点不能未经核对直接互换。
intro.en: Cable assemblies built around a specified HARTING Han interface for removable machines, control cabinets and equipment modules. The complete part references, mating half, circuit drawing and installation duty define the assembly; similarly named hoods, inserts and contacts are not automatically interchangeable.

knowledge.zh: Han 是矩形工业连接器家族，不是一种固定针位的插头。选型可能涉及外壳、底座、单体插芯或 Han-Modular 框架、功率／信号／数据模块、触点、锁扣与进线件。实际电气和环境能力取决于所选整套部件及其装配条件。
knowledge.en: Han is a family of rectangular industrial connectors, not one fixed pinout. A configuration may include hood, housing, monobloc insert or Han-Modular frame, power/signal/data modules, contacts, latches and cable entry. Electrical and environmental performance belongs to the specified complete assembly and its installation conditions.

notes.zh: 询价请提供 Han 系列与外壳尺寸、每个外壳／底座／插芯或模块／触点的料号、对插面视图、针脚与回路表、负载与电压、导体和护套、出线方向、格兰头与锁扣形式、安装环境、数量及验收要求。品牌兼容不代表 HARTING 授权或认证。
notes.en: For quotation, provide the Han series and housing size; part numbers for each hood, base, insert or module and contact; mating-face view, pin and circuit map, load and voltage, conductors and jacket, cable-exit direction, gland and latch choice, environment, quantity and acceptance criteria. Compatible work does not imply HARTING authorization or certification.

delivery.zh: 经客户确认后形成受控物料表、回路图、端接与装配指引、首件核对点和约定检验项目。重点核对插芯朝向、接点位置、触点入位、锁扣闭合、进线夹持、线长与导通；IP、防振或额定负载表现须按准确产品资料与项目试验单独证明。
delivery.en: Approved inputs become a controlled BOM, circuit drawing, termination and assembly instructions, first-article checkpoints and agreed inspections. Check insert orientation, contact position and seating, latch closure, cable-entry retention, length and continuity. IP, vibration or rated-load performance requires the exact product data and separately defined project evidence.

introduction.zh: Han 接口是一套系统，不只是一个插头
introduction.en: A Han interface is a system, not just a plug

subtitle.zh: 从外壳尺寸、插芯布局到电缆出口逐项确认
subtitle.en: Confirm housing size, insert layout and cable exit together

lead.zh: 先画出设备边界：哪一侧固定、哪一侧可拆，电力、控制和数据回路分别去哪里。然后按制造商资料确定外壳、底座、插芯或模块、触点、密封与锁紧件。本文图片用于说明相关结构及应用场景，只有经料号核对的部件才构成项目配置。
lead.en: Start at the equipment boundary: which side stays fixed, which side disconnects, and where power, control and data circuits go. Then specify hood, base, insert or modules, contacts, seals and locks from the manufacturer's documentation. Images illustrate related structures and contexts; only part-number-verified components form a project configuration.

title.zh: 先核对外壳、底座与锁扣的完整组合
title.en: Specify the complete hood, housing and latch combination

copy.zh: 矩形重载接口由线端外壳、设备端底座、插芯以及锁紧和进线部件共同工作。外壳尺寸相同，不表示锁扣位置、出线方向、安装孔位或防护等级就相同。应以两侧完整料号和对插面视图确认方向，并把上／侧出线、单／双锁扣、面板安装空间与开合操作空间写进设备图。图中的十极连接器只是通用重载接口实拍，不代表 HARTING 产品或本公司的出货记录。
copy.en: A rectangular heavy-duty interface works as a system of cable hood, equipment housing, insert, locking hardware and cable entry. The same housing size does not guarantee the same latch position, exit direction, mounting holes or protection level. Check full part references and mating-face views on both sides; document top/side entry, single/double latch and mounting and service clearances. The pictured ten-pole connector is a generic real-world example, not a HARTING product or a Super Smile shipment.

title.zh: 固定端与活动端分开标

copy.zh: 图纸要说明谁装在面板、谁随线缆移动。
copy.en: Show which half mounts to the panel and which travels with the cable.

title.zh: 把锁扣和出口列为物料
title.en: Treat latch and entry as parts

copy.zh: 只写“Han 插头”不足以完成采购或装配。
copy.en: “Han plug” alone is not a buildable purchase specification.

title.zh: 单体插芯与 Han-Modular 不能按外观替换
title.en: A monobloc insert is not a visual substitute for Han-Modular

copy.zh: Han E、Han D、Han DD 等家族和 Han-Modular 是不同的配置路径。模块化系统可以在批准的框架与模块组合中安排电力、信号或数据通道，但每种模块有自己的触点形式、位置、线径与额定条件。图中的控制模块仅展示设备内部不同回路并存的场景，并非 Han 模块。工程人员应先把回路按负载、隔离和信号完整性分组，再按制造商的配置规则、尺寸与额定表选择插芯或模块，不能凭“都能装入一个壳体”就认定可混装。
copy.en: Han E, Han D, Han DD and Han-Modular follow different configuration paths. A modular system can arrange power, signal or data in approved frame-and-module combinations, but each module has its own contact form, position, wire range and rating. The pictured controls show coexisting equipment circuits, not Han modules. Group circuits by load, separation and signal integrity first; then select inserts or modules using the manufacturer's configuration, size and rating data. A common hood alone does not authorize a mixed build.

copy.zh: 电力、控制与数据的针脚和屏蔽需要分别审核。
copy.en: Review power, control, data and shielding separately.

copy.zh: 框架位号与模块料号须能对应到图纸。
copy.en: Map frame positions and module references to the drawing.

title.zh: 剥皮、端接与触点保持是三道不同的检查
title.en: Cutting, termination and contact retention are separate checks

copy.zh: 先依据触点与导体的批准范围确定截面、剥皮长度和加工方法。Han 系列有不同的压接、螺钉或弹簧连接方案，工艺和工具不能跨触点照搬。切线照片只展示准备步骤，并非压接或项目验收记录。端接后还应确认裸铜没有过长外露、绝缘未压入不应进入的位置、触点完全入位且在插拔时不会退针；导通合格也不能代替压接质量与保持检查。
copy.en: Choose conductor cross-section, strip length and method from the approved contact and wire range. Han variants use different crimp, screw or spring-cage terminations; tooling and instructions cannot be copied across contacts. The cutting photo illustrates preparation only, not a crimp or project inspection record. After termination, check exposed conductor, insulation position, full contact seating and retention during mating. Continuity cannot replace a termination-quality or retention check.

copy.zh: 触点料号、工具和线径范围要相互匹配。
copy.en: Match contact number, tool and conductor range.

copy.zh: 外观、保持与电气项目各有自己的接收标准。
copy.en: Visual, retention and electrical checks need distinct criteria.

title.zh: 格兰头、护套与弯曲缓解要匹配整条电缆
title.en: Match gland, jacket and bend relief to the cable

copy.zh: 外壳防护能力不能脱离进线口与对插状态单独讨论。所选格兰头的夹持范围要覆盖实际护套外径，密封件要适应环境和装配方式，护套结构应承受项目的油污、粉尘、清洗与温度条件。照片展示拆开的通用格兰头及其密封件，并非指定 Han 配件。若线缆随可拆模块移动，还应给出固定点、最小弯曲半径、拖拽风险和拆装余量，避免锁扣或触点成为受力点。
copy.en: Housing protection cannot be assessed apart from cable entry and mated condition. The selected gland's clamping range must match the actual jacket diameter; seals and jacket must suit the installation, oil, dust, cleaning and temperature exposure. The photo shows a disassembled generic cable gland and seal, not specified Han parts. For a movable module, document fixing points, bend radius, pull risk and service loop so the latch and contacts do not become strain-relief devices.

copy.zh: 标称线径不能替代格兰头夹持尺寸。
copy.en: Nominal conductor size does not set gland clamping diameter.

copy.zh: 壳体、密封、进线与对插端需一起核查。
copy.en: Check hood, seal, entry and mating half together.

title.zh: 可拆卸机台与柜体外接线需要不同走线
title.en: Removable machines and enclosures need different routing

copy.zh: Han 接口常被放在设备模块与固定布线的边界，但安装位置决定实际线束设计。机台可拆单元看重拆装可达、锁扣操作、运动余量和防误插；柜体或室外设备还要考虑进线方向、雨水路径、线缆支撑与维护通道。配图只是室外电气箱安装环境，不表示箱体使用 HARTING 接头。制作前应让客户标明固定端位置、现场对插方向、线缆支撑点和最坏维护姿态，再确认线长与出口角度。
copy.en: A Han interface may sit at the boundary between a removable module and fixed wiring, but the position determines the cable design. Machine modules require mating access, latch operation, movement allowance and mis-mating prevention; enclosures and outdoor equipment add cable-entry direction, water path, support and service access. The image is a generic outdoor electrical-box context, not evidence of HARTING use. Ask the customer to mark the fixed half, mating direction, cable support and worst-case service position before setting length and exit angle.

copy.zh: 出线角度错误，增加线长也无法解决干涉。
copy.en: More cable cannot correct a conflicting exit direction.

copy.zh: 锁扣和线缆都要留有可操作空间。
copy.en: Allow operating room for both latch and cable.

title.zh: 拿准确对插件审核，而不是只看单根成品线
title.en: Inspect against the approved mating half, not a cable alone

copy.zh: 旧样可帮助识别尺寸与出线方式，但旧样可能有替代插芯或现场维修痕迹。首件应按批准的物料表和回路图核对每个模块位号、针脚、导线标识、触点入位、锁扣闭合、进线夹持、线长与导通；条件允许时与实际对插件试装。照片展示一般设备检查场景，不是我司该产品的测试记录。若项目要求绝缘、耐压、防护或振动验证，应在合同和检验计划中明确方法、样本与接受值，不能由普通导通结果推断。
copy.en: A used sample helps identify size and cable exit, but may hide substituted inserts or field repairs. Check the first article against the approved BOM and circuit drawing: module position, pins, wire IDs, contact seating, latch closure, cable-entry retention, length and continuity; mate with the approved opposite half when available. The image is general equipment-inspection context, not a test record for this product. Insulation, dielectric, ingress or vibration validation needs explicitly agreed methods, samples and acceptance values; it cannot be inferred from a continuity pass.

copy.zh: 外壳、插芯、触点与对插件版本都须可追溯。
copy.en: Trace hood, insert, contacts and mating revisions.

copy.zh: 导通不等于环境防护或整机认证。
copy.en: Continuity is not ingress protection or equipment certification.

q.zh: 只知道 Han 外壳尺寸，能确定线束吗？
q.en: Is the Han housing size enough to specify a cable?

a.zh: 不够。还需两侧外壳与底座、插芯或模块、触点、锁扣、进线件、针脚与线材的准确配置。
a.en: No. Confirm both hoods and housings, insert or modules, contacts, latches, cable entry, pinout and cable specification.

q.zh: Han-Modular 能直接替换单体插芯吗？
q.en: Can Han-Modular directly replace a monobloc insert?

a.zh: 不能凭尺寸判断。模块框架、空位、接点、负载与隔离条件都要重新工程审核并经客户批准。
a.en: Not by size alone. The frame, cavities, contacts, load and separation conditions need a new engineering review and customer approval.

q.zh: 外壳标注的 IP 等级等于整条线束的防护等级吗？
q.en: Does the hood's IP marking rate the entire cable assembly?

a.zh: 不等于。实际防护取决于指定的壳体、密封、格兰头、电缆外径、装配与正确对插状态，项目要求需按准确资料和试验核对。
a.en: No. Actual protection depends on the specified housing, seals, gland, cable diameter, assembly and properly mated condition; confirm the project claim against exact data and tests.

q.zh: 同一接口能同时放电力和数据吗？
q.en: Can one interface carry power and data?

a.zh: Han-Modular 存在可组合的模块路径，但能否同壳使用取决于制造商允许的模块、间距、额定值、屏蔽与项目电气隔离要求。
a.en: Han-Modular offers combination paths, but a mixed build depends on approved modules, spacing, ratings, shielding and the project's electrical-separation requirements.

q.zh: 询价时最重要的资料是什么？
q.en: What information matters most for a quotation?

a.zh: 请给完整料号或两侧清晰对插照片、针脚表、负载、线材与长度、出线方向、安装环境、数量及验收要求。资料未定时可以先做接口审核，不宜直接承诺兼容。
a.en: Send complete part references or clear mating-face photos of both halves, pin map, loads, wire and length, exit direction, environment, quantity and acceptance criteria. If references are unresolved, start with an interface review rather than promising compatibility.
